nodes.label: Anatomy of a Losing Trade Chart
nodes.description: H1 price chart titled 'Анатомия убыточной сделки — 4 типичные ошибки' (Anatomy of a losing trade — 4 typical mistakes). Shows a rising price line (approx 1.0845–1.1120) over ~80 candles with 4 annotated trading errors.

nodes.label: Error 1: FOMO Entry Without Clear Signal
nodes.description: ОШИБКА 1: Вход без чёткого сигнала (FOMO) — entering a trade without a clear signal, driven by fear of missing out, annotated near candle 17 on the price chart.

nodes.label: Error 2: Stop Loss Too Close (20 pips on volatile pair)
nodes.description: ОШИБКА 2: Стоп слишком близко (20 пипсов на волатильной паре) — stop loss placed too close at 20 pips on a volatile currency pair, annotated near candle 35.

nodes.label: Error 3: Stop Moved Further to Give the Trade a Chance
nodes.description: ОШИБКА 3: Двинул стоп дальше 'чтобы дать шанс' — moving the stop loss further away to give the trade more room, annotated near candle 52.

nodes.label: Error 4: Closed Manually at Peak Pain Without Waiting for Stop
nodes.description: ОШИБКА 4: Закрыл руками на максимуме боли, не дождавшись стопа — manually closed the trade at the peak of emotional pain without waiting for the stop loss to trigger, annotated near candle 68.

nodes.label: Trading Psychology Mistakes
nodes.description: The image as a whole illustrates common psychological and risk-management errors made by beginner traders: FOMO entry, tight stop loss, stop loss manipulation, and emotional exit.
